test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding fertilizers?

options.text: They are very rich in plant nutrients
They provide humus to the soil

solution:
The correct answer is __**They provide humus to the soil.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Fertilizers are man-made inorganic salts that are prepared in factories to provide essential plant nutrients to soil.
 
• They are used to enhance plant growth and increase crop yield.
 
• Fertilizers do not provide humus to the soil, which is the organic matter that results from the decomposition of plant and animal material.
 
• Humus is important for soil structure, water retention, and nutrient availability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Fertilizers:

 
• Fertilizers are chemical compounds that are used to maintain a good harvest and improve soil fertility.
 
• It is used excessively in agricultural processes.
 
• Fertilizers increase crop productivity.
 
• Example:- granular triple super phosphate, urea, potassium chloride, anhydrous ammonia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4f1b7b6b1ec2774f5d70161966bbd41d8c10e6f8e88532de36144b4ba3a9eb1.png]
